name: Hossana
assessment: Official Hossana municipal custody was evidenced through the municipality's public portal, which lists land-holding information registration and a cadastral-matter service. The inspected routes are service-request workflows, not anonymous parcel-feature delivery; no safe ID-plus-polygon response was qualified.
queryAndRequestOutcome: English and Amharic first-party discovery were performed separately and recorded in the city packet. Anonymous HTTPS GETs to the municipal home page, service index, cadastral service-sector page, and land-holding information registration page succeeded with TLS verification. The returned HTML exposed service categories and request links but no map configuration, public GIS/API route, parcel schema, CRS, native parcel identity, or geometry. Addis Ababa's separate e-Land map was noted as out of scope for Hossana.

localRegistryCustodian.evidence: Hossana City Administration's official portal names the municipal online service system and exposes the land-holding information registration sector plus a cadastral-matter service.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not run against a verified parcel endpoint; exact point remains unchanged and no absence inference is made.
